description: Canonical P0 failure shapes from the V2 raw studies. Each case must fail closed through schema, validator or deterministic runtime checks.

cases.forbidden: worker profile instructs an agent to choose phase, choose route, approve gate or mutate state
a P0 study finding marked as closed with documentation only
a P0 study finding marked as closed with schema but no runtime or test reference
human gate asks the operator for approval before material, package and delivery receipt exist
Solana or onchain work passes F4+ without Solana AI Kit provider or usage receipt
cases.expected_guard: factoryctl validate-card and board reconcile route repair

cases.forbidden: security contract is a prose receipt without boundary, owner, controls or evidence
repo-only, static or bounded proof is reported as production-ready
cases.expected_guard: readiness truth ledger and factory truth packet

cases.forbidden: public reference superiority claim has no schema, reducer, test and negative fixture proof
